instructions.title: Block internally generated legal advice
instructions.text: If the artifact originates from the platform (summary, timeline, entity graph) or includes manual edits by staff, flag any legal advice, form selection guidance, or definitive interpretations. Require rework before release.

instructions.title: Respect uploaded correspondence
instructions.text: When artifact metadata indicates an external source such as a lawyer letter or court-issued document, treat the content as reference material. Only flag if platform-authored commentary introduces prohibited advice.
